description: Agent Learning: submit an agent’s candidate and adopted lessons with the evidence behind them: each lesson with its id, the lesson as stated, its status (a candidate, an adopted standing rule or a retired lesson), when it was adopted, how many episodes support it, how many episodes checked contradict it, whether it was tested against evidence before adoption, such as a replay, a trial or a held-out set of episodes, and when it was tested; and optionally how many supporting episodes an adopted lesson needs (3 when left out). The signed report gives every lesson with its status, its evidence for and against, its test and whether the test came after the adoption, and its reading as validated, anecdote, contradicted, adopted_early, thin, untested, candidate, retired or unconfirmed, counts the lessons adopted, validated, kept as candidates and retired, and states the threshold, and names anecdotes made into standing rules: lessons adopted on a single episode or none, lessons adopted with as many contradicting episodes as supporting ones, and lessons adopted before the test that should have validated them; then lessons adopted on fewer supporting episodes than the threshold and lessons adopted untested, with the fix for each. This reads whether the agent’s own lessons were validated before adoption: stated confidence read against a hit rate is wever_uncertainty-calibration-check, the set an agent is scored on is wever_evaluation-dataset-check, and one claim read against offered evidence is wever_claim-evidence-check. Verdict anecdote_as_rule, validation_light, validation_absent or lessons_validated. POST /api/learning-validation-check. Reads only the recorded episodes, lessons and records in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no lesson is written, changed or retired and no memory or model is updated. Agent Learning reads whether an agent improves from its own experience, from the lessons it captures to the lessons it keeps: it is not the loop on feedback received (whether outside feedback was incorporated, the wever_feedback checks; learning begins where that ends and reads the agent’s own lesson records over time), not a knowledge store (stored knowledge and its retrieval, the wever_knowledge checks; learning is improvement from experience), not memory design (how memory is structured, wever_memory-design-check; this family reads what the lessons in it are worth), not the confidence an agent states in its answers (the wever_uncertainty checks) and not the promises it makes (the wever_commitment checks). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-learning-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-learning/.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

adopted_at.description: When it was adopted as a standing rule.

id.description: The lesson id, such as l1.

status.description: A candidate, an adopted standing rule or a retired lesson.

tested.description: It was tested against evidence before adoption, such as a replay, a trial or a held-out set of episodes.

min_evidence.description: Supporting episodes an adopted lesson needs; 3 when left out.
